Court Delivered The Following:
Coram: The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Shivashankar Amarannavar
 Judgment

This appeal is directed against the judgment and award dated 05.04.2012 passed by the learned Senior Civil Judge, Bailhongal in LAC No.252/2011.
2.

The appellants' land bearing Sy.Nos.86 measuring 25 guntas and 83/3A+3B+5+6+7+8B measuring 1 acre 23 guntas were acquired under Notification dated 20.10.2009 issued under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act 1894 for the propose of Malaprabha Project and consequently the SLAO has passed an award awarding compensation of Rs.35,096/- per acre.
On reference application filed by the appellants, the reference Court enhanced the compensation to Rs.2,94,000/- per NC: 2024:KHC-D:11660 acre.
Being aggrieved, the appellants are before this Court seeking enhancement of compensation.

3. It is discerned from the records that the lands acquired herein are similarly situated acquired for the same project as that of the lands considered by this Court in MSA No.100012/2016 and connected matters disposed of on 19.07.2016 which is not disputed by the learned counsel for the respondent.
4.

In view of the same, this appeal is allowed in terms of the judgment passed by this Court in Razaqsab and Another v. SLAO and another in MSA No.100012/2016 and connected matters disposed of on 19.07.2016 enhancing the compensation awarded by the Reference Court to Shivappa Dundappa Ganachari vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48211827/
2 Rs.5,08,000/- per acre with all statutory benefits and costs by denying interest for delayed period of 2,290 days in filing the appeal.
5.

sentences.text:
In the result, the impugned judgment and award dated 05.04.2012 passed by the learned NC:
2024:KHC-D:11660 Senior Civil Judge, Bailhongal, in LAC No.252/2011 is set aside.
The market value of the acquired land of the appellants is fixed at Rs.5,08,000/- per acre with all statutory benefits and costs.
Draw award accordingly.

Sd/-
(SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR) JUDGE kmv CT:CNB Shivappa Dundappa Ganachari vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48211827/
